confirmed_findings.statement: SBI VC Trade offers a customer-funded XRP accumulation order: JPY 500–2,000,000 per order, daily/weekly/monthly scheduling, with customer JPY prefunding required.
The SBI VISA Crypto Card converts eligible points monthly into one selected crypto asset, including XRP; Standard and Gold base reward rates are 0.5% and 1.0% of eligible spend respectively.

The September–October 2026 card acquisition campaign's application window had ended by 2026-11-01 01:29 JST. The card product and ordinary monthly reward mechanics remain distinct from the expired sign-up campaign.

actual_capital_separation.customer_funded_scheduled_purchase: MECHANISM_CONFIRMED; XRP-SPECIFIC ORDERS AND EXECUTION VOLUME UNKNOWN
actual_capital_separation.card_points_conversion: REWARD_DISTRIBUTION; NOT EVIDENCE OF CUSTOMER-FUNDED OPEN-MARKET BUY
actual_capital_separation.campaign_rewards: TIME-LIMITED REWARD LIABILITY; APPLICATION WINDOW CLOSED IN JAPAN

hypotheses.claim: The scheduled accumulation service can generate recurring customer-funded XRP purchase demand when customers select XRP and maintain sufficient JPY balances.
support: Official SBI VC Trade product page specifies automatic scheduled purchases, XRP eligibility and JPY order limits.
disconfirming: No XRP-specific subscriber, order, fill, sourcing or venue data is disclosed.
SBI VC Trade may internalize orders or source inventory away from the public order book.
hypotheses.next_test: Obtain XRP-specific monthly plan counts, executed order quantities, price/venue records and inventory reconciliation.

hypotheses.claim: Monthly card-point conversion may distribute XRP to cardholders but does not prove open-market XRP buying.
support: Official card page documents monthly conversion and one-asset selection including XRP.
disconfirming: No XRP selection share, reward units or inventory procurement data is disclosed.
hypotheses.next_test: Obtain monthly selected-asset mix, reward liability, XRP credited and source-of-inventory disclosures.

forecast.reason: Product availability and reward mechanics do not provide measured executed flow or predictive validation.

safety: Research only. No orders, paper-trading state changes, account access or external financial actions.
